groups.title: ISPM 15 Wood Packaging
groups.summary: Fumigation and stamping of wood packaging to the ISPM 15 standard, for pallets, crates and dunnage.
groups.intro: ISPM 15 is an international phytosanitary measure developed by the International Plant Protection Convention that addresses the need to treat wood materials thicker than 6mm used to ship products between countries. Its purpose is to prevent the international transport and spread of disease and insects that could harm plants or ecosystems. All World Fumigation is accredited to the ISPM 15 Wood Packaging Program standard for fumigation of export wood products.
groups.imageAlt: Hardwood logs marked in red and loaded in a shipping container

services.title: ISPM Stamping
services.text: ISPM 15 requires wood packaging to be debarked and then heat treated or fumigated with methyl bromide, and stamped or branded with a mark of compliance. That mark is colloquially known as the wheat stamp.
points: Products made from paper, plastic or wood panel products are exempt from ISPM 15

services.title: MB (Methyl Bromide)
services.text: Treatment that completely fills an area with methyl bromide, a gaseous pesticide. Quarantine authorities around the world have stipulated that methyl bromide fumigation has to be carried out for packaging materials made out of wood or straw.
points: Most widely used fumigant for quarantine purposes, and the preferred fumigant of most quarantine authorities around the world
Good penetrating ability and rapid action
High toxicity to a broad spectrum of insects and pests, and effective against all stages of insects, from egg to adult
Frequently used on timber, agricultural products, empty containers, foodstuffs and other agricultural produce
Aeration is quick and easy, so fumigant residue problems do not occur

services.title: Container Fumigation
services.text: The container the wooden packaging is placed in is completely filled with methyl bromide. After a 24-hour quarantine, the container is aerated and the wood or cargo is released.

services.title: Tent Fumigation
services.text: The wooden packaging is covered with a specific type of tent, sealed to the ground with weight, and the tent is completely filled with methyl bromide. After a 24-hour quarantine, the tent is removed and the wood or cargo is released.
points: Sealed with weight along the edge
24-hour quarantine, then the tent comes off

services.title: Pallet Fumigation and Timber Treatment
services.text: Pallet fumigation and timber treatment, along with crate stamping and fumigating, for exports that need their packaging certified.

groups.title: Quarantine Fumigation
groups.summary: USDA and PPQ fumigation of cargo held by U.S. Customs, and fumigation for destination countries that require it.
groups.intro: Plant Protection and Quarantine (PPQ) is a program within the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS), an agency of the United States Department of Agriculture. The PPQ program works to safeguard agriculture and natural resources in the United States against the entry, establishment and spread of animal and plant pests and noxious weeds. All World Fumigation is a USDA certified company to treat quarantined commodities placed on hold by CBP, U.S. Customs.
groups.imageAlt: Cargo sealed under a fumigation tarp on a concrete pad

services.title: USDA Quarantine Fumigation
services.text: Quarantine fumigation of commodities entering the United States under USAID and APHIS jurisdiction, which requires fumigation of specific commodities to prevent the import of pests or disease.
points: Commodities placed on hold by CBP, U.S. Customs

services.title: Import Cargo
services.text: Pest Plant Quarantine fumigation of import cargo. We are accredited to carry out fumigation of imports.

services.title: Export Cargo
services.text: Pest Plant Quarantine fumigation of export cargo, from exports that need certification of packaging through to tarped container fumigations.

services.title: Chilean Fumigation
services.text: The Chilean government requires certain cargos imported into Chilean ports to be fumigated. The Chilean Agricultural and Livestock Service (SAG) requires that any second-hand clothes, toys, vehicles or similar used merchandise must be fumigated.
points: Intended to keep out Halyomorpha halys, reported in China, Korea, Taiwan, Japan and the United States

groups.title: AQIS Cleaning and Fumigation
groups.summary: Steam cleaning and fumigation of machinery bound for Australia, to the biosecurity conditions set for import.
groups.intro: To help protect Australia's unique environment from unwanted pests and diseases, the Department of Agriculture and Water Resources regulates products imported into Australia. The importation of some products is, by law, subject to certain biosecurity import conditions: some products are not permitted entry, while others are only allowed in once they meet import conditions that mitigate the biosecurity risk. All World Fumigation is an AUS-treat pre-border treatment provider and can handle every type of machinery.
groups.imageAlt: A wheel loader standing on a lined wash pad after cleaning

about.title: We do this everyday
text: All World Fumigation & Cleaning LLC works out of La Porte, Texas, with over 15 years of experience. We fumigate on a large scale and a small scale, for imports and exports.

We are licensed, bonded and insured, and certified by the United States Department of Agriculture to treat imported commodities that have been quarantined by U.S. Customs. We are accredited to carry out fumigation of imports, and accredited to the ISPM 15 Wood Packaging Program standard for fumigation of export wood products.
From exports requiring certification of packaging to tarped container fumigations, we do it. All services can be provided using aluminum phosphide, sulfuryl fluoride and methyl bromide.
